requirements: R1: Resolve backend container startup failure and ensure the /health endpoint is reachable on port 18080

slices.title: Fix backend application startup failure
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backend startup fix for this epic, I want to resolve the connection refused error, so that the launched environment can be utilized and verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend application with a failing health check,
When the application is launched and its test suite is executed,
Then it must pass context load tests and the /health endpoint must return a healthy HTTP status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase backend successful startup rate from 0% to 100%.
